name: Cenlub Industries Limited
about: Cenlub Industries Limited, an engineering company, designs, engineers, manufactures, supplies, installs, and erects lubrication systems for various machines, plants, and equipment in India. Its product portfolio includes lubrication systems comprising single shot oil products, such as manual and motorized pumps, metering cartridge, tubing and fittings, and accessories; progressive grease lubrication products, including manual grease, motorized grease, and pneumatic grease pumps, as well as multi line radial lubrication; air oil spray lubrication; and dual line grease lubrication system and accessories, such as dose feeders, hydraulic over pressure reversing valve, electrical change over valve, filters, end pressure replay, and electrical control panels. The company also offers grease spray lubrication products, including pneumatic grease pumps, grease spray nozzles, and distribution blocks; and rail track lubrication systems, as well as oil circulation/lube oil systems. In addition, it provides seal oil skid, stator water cooling system, gas units, jacking oil system, flushing stands, fuel transfer/oil skids, and chemical dosing skids. The company serves automation, cement plant, construction/earth moving equipment, defense equipment, escalator, machine tools, material handling/mining equipment, packaging, printing, plastic, oil and gas refineries/petrochemical, power plant, pulp, rail track lubrication system, steel and sponge iron plant, sugar plant, and wind turbine industries. It also exports its products. Cenlub Industries Limited was incorporated in 1992 and is headquartered in Faridabad, India.
